req.title: Login sets session on success
req.statement: The system shall set session['user_id'] and redirect to / when POST /auth/login receives a matching username and password.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that a successful login should set the session['user_id'] and redirect to the homepage. To ensure this behavior, we need to test a successful login (positive case), an unsuccessful login due to incorrect credentials (negative case), and a boundary case where the username is at the minimum valid length.

tests.name: test_successful_login
preconditions: User 'testuser' with password 'testpass' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Setup: Register a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Test: Successful login
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
with client.session_transaction() as session:
    assert 'user_id' in session

tests.name: test_unsuccessful_login_incorrect_password
preconditions: User 'testuser' with password 'testpass' exists in the database.
actions: POST /auth/login with username 'testuser' and incorrect password 'wrongpass'.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

# Setup: Register a user
client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Test: Unsuccessful login with incorrect password
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'testuser', 'password': 'wrongpass'})
assert r.status_code == 200
assert b'Incorrect password.' in r.data
with client.session_transaction() as session:
    assert 'user_id' not in session

tests.name: test_login_minimum_username_length
preconditions: User 'a' with password 'testpass' exists in the database.
tests.executable:
from flaskr import create_app
import tempfile, os
fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
client = app.test_client()

client.post('/auth/register', data={'username': 'a', 'password': 'testpass'})

# Test: Login with minimum username length
r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'a', 'password': 'testpass'})
assert r.status_code == 302
assert r.headers['Location'] == '/'
with client.session_transaction() as session:
    assert 'user_id' in session
